events.why: step 64: the lab gate asks for five registered species, 3/5 after the tutorial: two new ones here in Wild Zone 1 before leaving, so the gate's scene finds 5/5 (user, 2026-11-13). From Taunie's rocks the search stays in the zone: it turns the camera in 8 steps with a ZL lock-on after each and throws only at targets whose plate shows no caught mark; a full turn with nothing new takes one short leg, each leg out walked back, none toward the objective at an agreed marker read of 60 or less (far gate ~55); after a round of legs it stands for spawns. 10 minutes, 12 throws at most. The marker's distance no longer steers it: six runs walking between distance stops on console B (2026-11-16) left the zone or stuck at ~87-89 with the digits unread (user's pick, 2026-11-16). The party bar's filled slots decide, read before the first look and after each throw: 5 means done, since the "Registered!" banner is missed at times (console B 2026-11-14 19:36: Mareep in the party, no banner seen).
